sampling: Existing five predeclared CTX windows C,NW,NE,SW,SE and three fixed MOC windows; one existing uncalibrated CTX native DN crop is supplemental only.
acceptance: All required: narrowest dimension >=8 map samples; >=3 repeatably identifiable bends/intersections; >=2 adjacent complete closed units, without inferring missing edges.
unknown: No accepted contours means width/area/density=NA, not0; does not establish absence.
no_processing: No sharpening, interpolation, smoothing, invented edges or segmentation. Native DN images inspected. Metadata geometry does not establish optical resolving power.
